title: Sensor plausibility and when the graph is physically impossible
whatItIs: A sensor can be wrong without setting a sensor-specific DTC. Plausibility means checking whether all sensors can be true at the same time under engine physics.
normalValues: Cold ECT/IAT should be near ambient, MAP key-on should be near barometric pressure, MAF should scale with RPM/load, and voltage/reference lines should stay stable.
deviations: MAF far above physical airflow with normal MAP/load is implausible
MAF far below expected with normal fuel and MAP can be under-reporting
ECT/IAT impossible at startup corrupts fueling
Low module voltage can create multiple unrelated sensor errors
influence: Plausibility prevents parts-cannon repairs. It also lets the app say 'insufficient data' when the graph cannot support a conclusion.
checks: Repair wiring and leaks before replacing expensive modules
